scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean proof source for local linear-elasticity theorems with no Physlib physics counterpart. Hash and compiled-name checks detect drift and provenance errors; they are not automatic symbolic translation or numerical validation.
interpretations: ElasticConstants is the fourth-rank stiffness tensor C_abcd on Cartesian indices a, b, c, d in 1..3, in one orientation for every component, with tensile-positive stress sigma_ab = sum_cd C_abcd e_cd for symmetric small strain, the negative of the catalog's compressive-positive Stress. Voigt 6x6 storage must be expanded to the full tensor with C_abcd = C_bacd = C_abdc, and Mandel or Kelvin storage converted, before the catalog sums apply.

BulkModulus and ShearModulus from contract_bulk_modulus and contract_shear_modulus are Voigt (uniform-strain) averages. Any tensor with the first minor symmetry that stores positive energy for every nonzero symmetric strain has positive Voigt moduli. For a cubic crystal the Voigt bulk modulus is the stress-controlled bulk modulus; the Voigt shear modulus of a cubic crystal is exact only at Zener ratio 1.
The isotropic results use C_abcd = lam d_ab d_cd + mu (d_ac d_bd + d_ad d_bc) and the cubic results use Voigt constants C11, C12, C44 with the cube axes along the Cartesian axes.

contract_youngs_modulus and contract_poisson_ratio take BulkModulus then ShearModulus. Their Lame values are checked for isotropic tensors; for anisotropic crystals they are Voigt-polycrystal estimates.

compute_bulk_modulus_eos is evaluated at the reference volume V0 of an energy-volume curve E(V). It equals the Voigt bulk modulus for a cubic linear-elastic cell with C12 <= C11 and C44 >= 0 whose energy is minimized over cell shape at each volume, and for any linear-elastic cell scaled uniformly without shape relaxation. Anharmonic energies, fitted equations of state, internal relaxation and pressure-dependent moduli are not covered.
